text:
alex: Quick heads-up — we need to coordinate a zero-downtime patch wave for cluster components next Tue/Wed. etdc/etcd-operator, kubelet minor, and ingress-controller have overlapping CVE windows. Can we sketch an execution plan?
maria: Which CVEs specifically? I want to check if any require config changes (RBAC/audit) vs just binary updates.
simon: CVE-2026-0421 (ingress ctrl) — fix needs a controller cfg change + CRD rollout. CVE-2026-0478 (kubelet) is a CVE that affects credential cache handling; requires kubelet restart. etcd fix is minor but needs member-by-member upgrade.
june: For kubelet restarts we should avoid mass-restarts on business hours. Suggest phased waves by AZ and drain+cordon.
dave: Confirming timelines: can we do canary in staging Mon and prod roll Tue night? We have capacity to shift load across AZs.
oncall: we should also plan fallback: if ingress controller upgrade breaks traffic, we roll back to previous image. Add readinessProbe grace to reduce flaps.
maria: RBAC question — ingress controller patch tightens webhook access. We'll need a temporary rolebinding for rollout job. @simon can you author the short-lived RBAC patch and an audit log verify step?
simon: Yup. I’ll add a Job that applies the rolebinding with a TTL and deletes it after rollout. Also adding `kubectl auth can-i` checks in the CI job.
sec-bot: Automated alert — existing audit-policy.yaml has path: /var/log/kube-apiserver/audit.log and audit-level=Metadata. Recommend enabling RequestResponse for webhook endpoints affected.
alex: Good catch. I want minimal increase in volume — can we target RequestResponse only for the ingress webhook namespace/pods?
june: Yes, we can add an audit policy rule scoped to namespace: ingress-nginx and match the URL path for admission webhooks. That keeps global volume low.
maria: KMS: etcd snapshot encryption keys rotation — do we need KMS downtime? We currently use KMS envelope keys via cloud-kms plugin. Rotating DEKs should be transparent but we need to verify restore flow. @dave can you validate a restore from a rotated snapshot in staging?
dave: I’ll run a full restore test after staging canary. ETA today EOD. Will post results.
oncall: reminder — update oncall playbook: document rollback commands + iptables failover for ingress. Add snippet: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/ingress-controller -n ingress-nginx` and `kubectl cordon/uncordon` steps.
simon: Also adding a quick smoke test after each AZ wave: `curl -I https://app.example.com/health` with latency thresholds. If >200ms error rate >5% -> pause wave.
maria: Approvals: security needs to sign off on RBAC and audit policy changes. @alex please add security-approval label in the PR.
alex: will do. Also adding feature-flag fallback: keep old ingress image in the registry so rollback is immediate.
deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-04-14T02:00Z to 2026-04-14T08:00Z (canary staging 2026-04-13T22:00Z). Reminder: tag images with patchwave/2026-04-14.
june: Can someone add a short runbook for the KMS key-rotation check? One-liner restore command + verification steps.
dave: Done — I’ll push the runbook to the incident docs repo and link here when complete.
oncall: after action items: list — 1) simon: RBAC Job + CI checks 2) maria: audit policy rule 3) dave: restore test 4) alex: PR + security label 5) june: AZ scheduling + smoke tests 6) oncall: update playbook.
alex: Thanks — let’s reconvene 1h before staging canary in #eng-release. :thumbsup:
